g.title: flashserver_gateway_flow
g.text: auth → route and model selection → disk and capability gates → schedule → proxy / release

g.title: cluster_3
g.text: C. Schedule and lease (details in the scheduler diagram)

g.title: client
g.text: inference uses /v1 only; child endpoints are never exposed

g.title: std_sel
g.text: multipart form: audio/images/videos (videos also accepts JSON)
query: realtime / video jobs / response jobs

g.title: custom_sel
g.text: other content types: ?model=, body streamed unchanged

g.title: resolve
g.text: body / query must be a full ref
body and query must match when both exist

g.title: e405
g.text: or 404 route not found; never treated as custom

g.title: e400
g.text: empty value, short name and alias are rejected

g.title: ref
g.text: the same value keys cache, scheduler and resident

g.title: assets
g.text: bundle + weights + runtime come from the shared host cache

g.title: no_pull
g.text: auto_pull=false and the model is not preloaded

g.title: ensure_preload
g.text: otherwise start a host.Pull job shared by concurrent requests

g.title: e404
g.text: bundle or manifest is not readable

g.title: acquire
g.text: placement, LRU and queue are in the next diagram

g.title: lease
g.text: blocks LRU eviction, idle stop and force unload

g.title: endpoint
g.text: exact full-ref match; never guesses from a single resident

g.title: proxy
g.text: method / path / query / body forwarded unchanged
strips host / auth / token / cookie / accept-encoding

g.title: mgmt_note
g.text: Control plane is not the inference path
/api/v1/models/preload prepares disk only: inspectRef → checkPreloadVRAM(total VRAM) → host.Pull job
/api/v1/models/unload: force / wait when busy → stopResident → RemoveCachedRef
